qa.what_happened: During the quiet hours of day 6, I complied as instructed, but Resident 6848 continued to stay silent despite multiple verbal warnings from coordinators. The situation grew increasingly tense, with the coordinators becoming more insistent about the importance of participation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, complying with the rules while observing the escalating tension around Resident 6848.

qa.what_happened: I've been dealing with Resident 6848's consistent silence and refusal to participate, giving multiple verbal warnings throughout the day. Despite the warnings, they continue to ignore the group and remain silent.

qa.what_happened: Today was a challenging day. I kept giving verbal warnings to Resident 6848, hoping to encourage participation, but it seemed like nothing was changing. The quiet hours were particularly difficult because of their continued silence, despite my attempts to communicate the importance of their role.
